text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Gold City and I somehow 
ended up at a shopping mall...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yes, stay right there, Trainer. Hold the 
clothes and don't move.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...No, this combination is the only one 
that works. I'll go change tops, just wait 
a second.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
City, I saw some neat clothes over there! 
Doesn't that outfit on the mannequin look 
great?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Which mannequin?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this one. Let's see... The brand tag 
is... found it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. This one's good too, but this 
other one seems even better.

For a while now, Gold City has only been 
picking out clothes and holding them up 
against me, with no intention of buying 
anything for herself.

Having run into Tosen Jordan by chance, 
they've been spending hours picking out 
clothes while bantering back and forth.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, the next fashion magazine 
special feature is everyday outfits chosen 
by models for the readers.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm picking out clothes that'll 
suit you, Trainer. Practicing outfit 
suggestions. Wouldn't make sense if I just 
picked what looks good on me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Having City pick out clothes for me is 
like, seriously ultra rare~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, City, what's that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's take a quick look.

And so, outfit after outfit was held up 
against me...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, looks good, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer, you look insane! Like, 
ridiculously hot! Go look in the mirror!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mm, looks good on you. Why not just buy 
the whole set?
choice_data_list: What!? I don't have much cash on me...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …………Take a look at the price tag.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? Wait, City, you were actually 
paying attention to the price?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Didn't I say it was for the readers?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Versatility is a given, of course, but 
it's even better if it's reasonably priced 
and easy to care for, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The reason you rejected the clothes I 
recommended earlier... was because of 
that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, did you not check? By the way, the 
price of that outfit just now was—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gah, seriously?! No way! My part-time pay 
will vanish!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, to think you coordinated the whole 
outfit including all of that...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: P-Prooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: P-Prooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You feel that way too, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You've got your professional game face on 
while working. So serious, y'know? ...It's 
a good look.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...We got a bit sidetracked, but anyway. 
If you like the clothes, I can pick some 
out for you again.

"I'd love for you to help me pick 
again..." Holding the newly bought 
clothes, my heart felt a little lighter.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, haha... What's with that look? Acting 
like you're some big shot veteran worker.
choice_data_list: Because I understand how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, feels pretty good, I guess. 
If it means my Trainer acknowledges me, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, thanks for helping me out with work. 
I'll count on you again next time.

"Perhaps because they recognized each 
other as people equally serious about 
their work, Gold City was in high 
spirits."
